hero.title: Start the right logistics task in one click.
intro: Track an LR, request a pickup, prepare a freight quotation or find the closest Vidhi Transport branch across Gujarat and Maharashtra.

sections.title: A practical freight service desk
intro: Each page keeps the important fields visible and prepares a complete message for your preferred contact channel.

cards.title: Track LR
body: Use your lorry receipt number to request the latest shipment record directly from the Vidhi ERP tracking service.

cards.title: Request pickup
body: Prepare origin, destination, cargo, packages, weight, date and handling details for an operations review.

cards.title: Request quote
body: Send a route-specific business enquiry for PTL, FTL, container, specialised freight or warehousing support.

cards.title: Find a branch
body: View addresses, direct phone numbers, capabilities and nearby service areas for all 14 listed locations.

sections.title: Continue with the right support channel
intro: Use a dedicated page for an inquiry, service complaint, dispatch-document check or infrastructure review.

cards.title: Business inquiry
body: Share a new freight, network or service requirement through the published inquiry channel.

cards.title: Service complaint
body: Register an issue with the LR number, route, contact information and factual incident details.

cards.title: Dispatch guidance
body: Review a practical GST and E-way Bill preparation checklist with links to official systems.

cards.title: Infrastructure
body: Understand the branch, planning, handling and shipment-visibility systems behind each movement.

sections.title: Keep six shipment facts ready.
intro: Accurate information gives the operations team a better basis for route, vehicle and service assessment.
list: Origin and destination Exact industrial areas and PIN codes.
Material Specific cargo description and classification.
Packages Type, count, dimensions and stackability.
Timing Ready date and delivery requirement.
Handling Forklift, crane, dock or labour needs.

closing.title: Start with the shipment details.
intro: Our contact page helps you prepare one complete business enquiry.
